base_config.note: base config unchanged; this file adds the fields the base left open and records the pre-execution fixes

blocker: no torch and no numpy in any interpreter, venv or pip/uv cache of this environment; no resource approval for installing them was given
reused_unchanged: train/dev/test rows (regenerated deterministically from the data seed keys; 2000/200/200)
standardisation of y, z by train sds for evaluation
Test P with N = 200, M = 64, B = 199, upper tail
architecture widths/depths, Adam lr 1e-3, batch 256, linear-path loss
Euler levels 32 and 128, base N(0, I), CFG off

controls.TRUE_JOINT_CONTROL and FITTED_JOINT_CONT: results reused from results/raw/p5_syn_learn_01_test; not re-run and not re-drawn
controls.limitation: per-example values and samples of the controls were not stored (summary only); they can be regenerated deterministically from the seeds (round-4 reproducibility check), but no paired comparison between a flow arm and a control is planned
controls.not_used_for: calibration, early stopping or any choice for the flow arms

pre_execution_fixes.D1_shared_role_encoding: shared network input = state(3) + observed mask(3) + target mask(3) + t; before the fix, absent and target coordinates had the same mask and z|x, y|x, y,z|x were distinguishable only by a slot value being exactly 0
pre_execution_fixes.D2_independent_optimizers: one Adam per independent MLP and zero_grad(set_to_none=True); before the fix a single Adam covered all four MLPs
pre_execution_fixes.status_of_fixed_code: UNTESTED until torch is available; tests/test_fm_adapter.py fixtures are SKIPPED without torch

SHARED_CONDITIONAL_FM.pattern_sampling: uniform i.i.d.; realised exposure recorded (expected 5000 each)

budget_contract.equal_compute: NO. Updates and parameter counts are about equal, but each shared update runs a network about 4x larger than the one independent network it replaces, so training and sampling FLOPs are about 4x for the shared arm. Report parameters, updates, exposure, wall-s and CPU-s; do not call the arms equal-compute.

training.data: train split only, raw (unstandardised) x, y, z
training.schedule: none (constant lr), no weight decay, no gradient clipping
training.checkpoint: final iterate after exactly the fixed number of updates; no early stopping; no checkpoint selection
training.model_seed: seed_v2(seed, experiment, joint='mixture3', condition=<arm>, level='-', example='all', replicate=0, branch='model_init')

allowed: dev flow-matching loss at 90% and 100% of updates with fixed dev noise (branch key 'dev_loss')
not_allowed: choosing the solver level by any outcome
changing data, seeds, widths, lr, batch or updates
looking at test before the dev labels are written

solver.rule: fixed a priori as the finer level; not chosen by any dev or test outcome
solver.seeds: sampling keys add solver_steps=<32|128> to the base sampling keys; permutation keys likewise

labels.MODEL_FIT_OR_NUMERICS_INCONCLUSIVE: for an arm, if any training loss or sample is non-finite; or if on dev the relative decrease of the dev flow-matching loss of any pattern between 90% and 100% of updates exceeds 2%; or if |mean ED_U(128) - mean ED_U(32)| > 1.645 * sqrt(se128^2 + se32^2) at the target level on dev or on test
labels.meaning: a label, not a verdict of incompatibility; all numbers are still reported; agreement of two levels does not prove ODE convergence
labels.INCOMPLETE_BUDGET: if the cap below is reached before both arms are trained and evaluated; untrained or partial models are not reported as results

evaluation.examples: the same 200 test examples for both arms; the conditioning example is the unit
evaluation.sampling: sequential branch draws a fresh y from the arm's own y|x for every sample; direct and sequential branches use separate seed streams; rows in a batch are independent (no batch-coupled layers); the observed y is never used
evaluation.primary_family: Test P at the target level (direct z|x vs sequential) for INDEPENDENT_CONDITIONAL_FM and SHARED_CONDITIONAL_FM at 128 steps: 2 tests, Holm at alpha = 0.05
evaluation.primary_comparison: paired per-example difference d_i = ED_U(IND)_i - ED_U(SHARED)_i at the target level (standardised), mean with normal 95% CI over the 200 examples; ED_U removes the finite-M bias of ED_V; the CI covers example and sampling noise, not training randomness (one model seed per arm)
evaluation.not_a_difference: one arm rejecting and the other not is not evidence that the arms differ; p-values are not ranked as scores
secondary_descriptive: projected-joint Test P and paired ED_U difference

quality to truth: unbiased sample energy distance between the arm's direct z|x samples and the true mixture conditional (closed-form cross and truth terms, U-statistic within-sample term), and the projected-joint analogue
diversity: direct-branch sample sd / true conditional sd
cost: parameters, updates, exposure, training and sampling wall-s and CPU-s, threads
evaluation.ratios: no ratio is a primary quantity; any reported ratio gets a bootstrap CI over examples that recomputes the whole ratio
evaluation.per_example_storage: store per-example ED_U, quality and sd values for both levels and both arms in raw

budget.scope: training both arms once plus dev and test evaluation at both levels

stop_rule: one model seed per arm; train once; evaluate dev, write labels, then evaluate test once; no reruns after seeing test

dependency_request.numpy: not required by the adapter; install only if torch import requires it
dependency_request.record: torch version, wheel filename, wheel sha256, index URL, pip freeze of the venv
dependency_request.not_included: CUDA builds, model weights, datasets, global installs
